blocks: Final status of every case in the checklist for Spicejet on Portal, 129 cases. Each case shows the result of its LATEST execution; earlier attempts stay in the group logs under automation_execution/.
Executed: 95 (Passed 87 · Failed 4 · Blocked 3 · Inconclusive 1). Not Applicable 5 · Not run 3 · Excluded 26. Pass rate of executed cases: 92%.

items.body: A multi-city booking never reaches Confirmed: three attempts went In Progress, the last with no leg space seat on any of its six seats (5F, 2A, 3A Window seat; 2B, 5E, 2B plain). Not explained by the leg space rule.
After Hold → Pay the booking is "Booked" and the wallet is charged the exact amount, but the ticket number is NONE — while the Dashboard moves one booking to TICKETED. Seen on all three attempts.

Multi-city confirmation lists Extra Baggage 27,000 for one 30 kg bag priced 13,500 (its lines add up to 68,219 against a total of 54,719); the itinerary shows none of the six seats, nor the meal and bag under their flights.

Multi-city Trip 3 (DEL→BLR, direct, 02-11-2026) offers no baggage: 4 baggage boxes for 3 journeys × 2 passengers, labelled Trip 1 and Trip 2 only — on Admin and Portal, 28 and 29 Oct. On 28 Oct Trip 3 had no meal either (8 meal boxes for 10); on 29 Oct all three journeys were direct and every flight had meals (6 of 6), so TC-SM-MCT-007 was Inconclusive (no connecting journey to judge).

The two flights of a connecting journey price seats differently (e.g. Trip 1: up to EGP 999 on one leg, EGP 149 on the other). TC-SM-MCT-007 expects the same; this may be normal per-aircraft pricing for Spicejet — business decision pending.

Intermittent: Next on a round trip is refused by /odeysysportal/v2/booking/add-pax with HTTP 400 "Invalid request … Total adult passengers count m…" (message cut off). Same passengers succeeded on the attempt in between; 3 of 4 attempts failed.
The e-ticket page of a booking that is only On Hold says "Congratulations! Your flight booking is confirmed".
